title: ISO 9001 quality (add-on)
description: ISO 9001:2026 on the Core registers: quality objectives, risks and opportunities, nonconformities and documents live in the shared registers with ISO 9001 columns, views and examples, and the add-on brings what only a quality system needs: processes, customer feedback and complaints, and in Full external providers, measuring equipment, release records and design and development. Installs the Core registers first. Written in our own words; no text of the standard.

levels.name: Starter
levels.description: Processes and customer feedback, ISO 9001 columns, views and examples on the Core registers, the Quality risk category and the audit-readiness dashboard.

levels.name: Full
levels.description: Everything in Starter plus external providers, measuring equipment and calibration, release records and design and development.

values.likelihood_scale: 1 Rare: has not happened here in five years. 2 Unlikely: happened once in the last few years. 3 Possible: happens about once a year. 4 Likely: happens every quarter. 5 Almost certain: happens every month.
values.impact_scale: 1 Negligible: caught before it reaches anyone. 2 Minor: one customer notices, put right the same day. 3 Moderate: a formal complaint or rework of a batch. 4 Major: a lost customer, a recall or a missed contract milestone. 5 Severe: harm to a user, loss of a key contract or certificate.

automations.name: Quality risk above appetite → owner treats it, the quality manager is told
automations.description: Escalation: when an ISO 9001 risk's score rises above 8 (the Quality category's appetite) and it is above its category's appetite, the risk owner is asked to plan the treatment and the quality manager is told, so a risk above appetite never waits for the next review.

actions.message: {id} {name} scores {score}, above the appetite of its category. Plan the treatment and set a review date.
{id} {name} is above appetite (score {score}). The risk owner has been asked to treat it.

automations.name: Quality objective off track → plan an action
automations.description: Cascade: when an ISO 9001 objective goes off track, an action to get it back on track is created in Actions, linked to the objective and owned by the objective's owner, due in 30 days, so the plan to recover is visible and followed up like any other action.

automations.name: Quality nonconformity closed without an effectiveness check → back to verification
automations.description: Gate: an ISO 9001 nonconformity cannot be closed until someone has checked that the corrective action worked. Closing it with Effectiveness verified unticked moves it back to Verification and tells the owner what is missing.

actions.message: Moved back to Verification: tick Effectiveness verified once you have checked the corrective action worked, then close it.

automations.name: Quality nonconformity 14 days overdue → tell the quality manager
automations.description: Escalation ladder, step 2: the owner is told the day after the due date (Core); when an ISO 9001 nonconformity is still open 14 days after its due date the quality manager is told, so it can be resourced or re-planned.

actions.message: {id} {name} was due on {due_date} and is still at {stage}. Plan what it needs to close.

automations.name: Quality nonconformity 30 days overdue → tell top management
automations.description: Escalation ladder, step 3: an ISO 9001 nonconformity still open 30 days after its due date goes to top management, who decide on resources or accept the delay; it is also an input to the next management review.

actions.message: {id} {name} is 30 days past its due date ({due_date}) and still at {stage}. Decide on resources or a new date.

items.name: Scope of the quality management system

automations.name: Process review in 30 days → ask the owner

actions.message: Review {id} {name} by {next_review}: are the inputs, outputs and measures still right? Submit it for approval when it changed.

automations.name: Process approved → next review in a year
automations.description: Recurring review cycle: when a process description is approved, its next review is set a year ahead, so the review reminder comes round again without anyone having to remember.

automations.name: Complaint answer due in 2 days → tell the handler
automations.description: SLA clock, step 1: a complaint must be answered within 10 days of receipt. Two days before the answer is due, the handler is reminded.

actions.message: {id} {name}: the customer should have our answer by {answer_due}.

automations.name: Complaint not answered in time → tell the quality manager
automations.description: SLA clock, step 2: when the 10 days have passed and the customer still has no answer, the quality manager is told the next day, so a late answer is caught before the customer chases it.

actions.message: {id} {name} from {customer} was due an answer on {answer_due} and has none yet.

automations.name: Complaint needs corrective action → raise a nonconformity
automations.description: Cascade: ticking Needs corrective action on customer feedback raises a linked nonconformity in Nonconformities and CAPA, tagged ISO 9001, with the product and what the customer said, so the root cause is found and fixed there.

automations.name: Calibration due in 30 days → tell the owner

actions.message: {equipment_id} {name} is due for calibration on {next_calibration}. Book it, or take it out of use.

automations.name: Calibration date passed → mark it due and tell the quality manager
automations.description: Escalation: the day after the calibration date, equipment that was not calibrated is marked Calibration due, so nobody trusts its readings, and the quality manager is told along with the owner.

actions.message: {equipment_id} {name} passed its calibration date ({next_calibration}). Do not use it until it is calibrated.

automations.name: Equipment out of tolerance → raise a nonconformity
automations.description: Cascade: equipment found out of tolerance raises a linked nonconformity tagged ISO 9001, so the results measured with it since the last good calibration are checked and the outcome recorded.

automations.name: Provider re-evaluation in 30 days → ask the owner

actions.message: Re-evaluate {name} against its criteria by {next_evaluation} and record the score.

automations.name: Release held → raise a nonconformity
automations.description: Cascade: a batch or order that is held at release raises a linked nonconformity tagged ISO 9001, so what happens to the held output (rework, concession, scrap) is decided and recorded.

automations.name: Design review in 7 days → tell the project lead

actions.message: The design review of {id} {name} is on {review_date}. Prepare the outputs and the open points.

setup.title: ISO 9001 setup
setup.description: Five steps to a quality system an auditor can follow, on the shared registers.

steps.title: Decide what applies
steps.body: Mark every ISO 9001 requirement applicable or not, with a reason for the ones that are not (design and development is the usual one).

steps.title: Describe your processes
steps.body: List the processes of your quality system with their owners, inputs, outputs and measures, and send each one for approval.

steps.title: Start logging customer feedback
steps.body: Share the complaint form with the people who talk to customers and log the feedback you already have.

steps.title: Evaluate your external providers
steps.body: List the providers that affect what you deliver, with criteria, a score and the next re-evaluation.

starter.title: Decide how you control providers
starter.body: Starter has no provider sheet: mark the external provider requirement in the library with how you control them, or add Full for the External providers register.

steps.title: Put measuring equipment on a calibration cycle
steps.body: List the equipment whose results you rely on, with its interval and next calibration date.

starter.title: Decide how you control measuring equipment
starter.body: Starter has no equipment register: record in the library how you keep measuring equipment fit for use, or add Full for the Measuring equipment register.
